record.dic_text:
01218 Botsqath {bots-kat'}

源自 01216; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Bozkath 1, Boscath 1; 2

波斯加 = "岩石高處"
1) 朝向非利士的猶大城巿, 約西亞母親的家 (#書 15:39; 王下 22:1|)
record.edic_text:
01218 Botsqath {bots-cath'}

from 01216;; n pr loc

AV - Bozkath 1, Boscath 1; 2

Bozkath or Boscath = "rocky height"
1) a city in Judah in the lowlands toward the Philistines, home of
   Josiah's mother
